newsitem.title: USA: SEC official applauds Calif. disclosure guidelines.
newsitem.headline: SEC official applauds Calif. disclosure guidelines.

text.p: A top Securities and Exchange Commission official Thursday said disclosure guidelines issued by a California state panel would help municipal bond issuers and professionals understand their responsibilities.

"It's going to help very much," Paul Maco, director of the office of municipal securities at SEC, told Reuters, referring to the California Debt Advisory Commission's guidelines. "I think any voluntary effort such as this helps participants understand their responsibilities both in a disclosure context and in dealing generally with investors."

Last week, Debt Advisory Commission adopted disclosure guidelines for land-based debt securities. The guidelines were designed to assist public officials in developing disclosure documents that fulfill their requirements under law and minimize their exposure to fraud liabilities.
Maco spoke Thursday at a conference on municipal bond disclosure in Berkeley, Calif. The conference was sponsored by Debt Advisory Commission.
